card.name: Oral dosing instructions: water, daily dose, morning
card.fires_on: The last word of an administration instruction, such as water after a full glass of, dose after single daily, morning after usually in the, or time after the same. It appears in tablet dosing directions.

modes.label: Water and food
modes.description: The word water or with ending a direction on how to take tablets.
modes.example: Varenicline tablets should be taken orally after eating and with a full glass of<< water>>.

modes.label: Daily dose
modes.description: The word dose after single daily in once-a-day directions.
modes.example: Ezetimibe and simvastatin tablets should be taken as a single daily<< dose>> in the evening, with or without food

modes.label: Time of day
modes.description: Morning or time ending a phrase about when to take the drug.
modes.example: The dose should be administered at approximately the same<< time>> every day.
